req_a.text: The TJA system shall control longitudinal acceleration and deceleration based on front radar target distance.

req_b.text: The TJA system shall bring the vehicle to a full stop when the preceding vehicle stops.

req_a.text: The system shall resume vehicle motion automatically if the preceding vehicle moves within 3 seconds of stopping.

req_b.text: If the preceding vehicle remains stopped for longer than 3 seconds, the driver must tap the accelerator pedal to resume TJA.

req_a.text: The system shall issue a visual and acoustic driver takeover request if lane markings become indistinguishable for more than 2 seconds.

req_b.text: The lateral control subsystem shall keep the vehicle centered within the detected lane boundaries.

req_a.text: The TJA system shall disengage immediately upon driver brake pedal intervention.

req_b.text: The TJA system shall control longitudinal acceleration and deceleration based on front radar target distance.

req_a.text: The TJA system shall require active engagement of the driver hand-on-wheel sensor every 15 seconds.

req_b.text: The TJA system shall maintain a user-selected headway time gap of 1.0s, 1.5s, or 2.0s to the preceding vehicle.
